in_hebrew.name: Dannye
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Dannye הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew name Dan, meaning 'Judge' or 'God's judge'. In the New Testament, Daniel is a prophet and interpreter of dreams. Dannye can be considered a variation of Daniel and means 'God's gift'.

in_greek.long_meaning: Dannye είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Hebrew name Dan, meaning 'Judge' or 'God's judge'. In the New Testament, Daniel is a prophet and interpreter of dreams. Dannye can be considered a variation of Daniel and means 'God's gift'.

in_latin.name: Dannye
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's gift
